verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents multiple standard OAuth 2.0/OIDC flows (client-credentials, device-authorization 'ratified in OAuth 2.0') and positions itself as the layer that secures APIs with OAuth 2.0 so developers don't hand-roll protocol details, plus community reports confirm quick real-world integration (e.g. 'integrated Auth0 in 2 days'). Missing for 10: explicit documentation citations for authorization-code-with-PKCE flow and refresh-token handling/rotation, and independent hands-on verification specifically of PKCE/refresh flows rather than general auth flows.
